plugins.name: mtask
plugins.description: Multi-agent task orchestration: /mtask for parallel sub-agent orchestration with worktrees, SSOT-anchored plans, and a single integrity gate. /mtask-toggle for session-scoped routing where every prompt becomes an mtask invocation until disabled.

plugins.name: metaplan
plugins.description: Process planner: /metaplan decomposes a project into phases and routes each phase to the right installed skill, with checkpoint re-evaluation between phases, scope-change consults with explicit cost, and a hard never-execute rule — the operator authorizes every phase launch.
